tldr: Mercury through the 9th house brings focus to travel, study, belief, publishing, law, and spiritual perspective.
body: Mercury transiting the 9th house activates travel, study, belief, publishing, law, and spiritual perspective. For a few weeks, thought, conversation, planning, and messages move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a thinking transit: it favors planning, conversations, edits, decisions, and information-gathering around the house topic.
business: Mercury supports learning, teaching, and widening the view: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Overthinking, mixed messages, or using certainty to avoid humility.
advice: Name the details in the 9th house deliberately. Work with travel, study, belief, publishing, law, and spiritual perspective without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
